desc:
Gravity is a suggestion. Your chalkboard makes the rules.

Become a mad physicist in a ridiculous laboratory where the laws of physics are yours to rewrite. Draw equations, launch experiments, and solve increasingly strange challenges.

📝 YOUR EXPERIMENT STARTS HERE
• Draw simple equations—no physics knowledge needed.
• Change gravity, bounce, and friction.
• Combine laws and test your own solutions.
• Unlock scientist styles and master the lab.

Draw it. Test it. Break physics.
